verses.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees said to him, 'You are giving testimony about yourself; your testimony is not true.'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don’t know where I come from or where I am going.'

verses.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.decoded: You judge by human standards; I do not judge anyone.

verses.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.decoded: But even if I do judge, my judgment is true because I am not alone. I and the Father who sent me stand together.

verses.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.decoded: Your own law says that the testimony of two people is true.

verses.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.decoded: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me also testifies about me.'

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Where is your Father?' Jesus replied, 'You don’t know me or my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.'

verses.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.decoded: Jesus said these things while teaching in the temple area near the treasury, but no one arrested him because his time had not yet come.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.decoded: Again Jesus said, 'I am going away, and you will look for me but die in your sins. Where I go, you cannot come.'

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.decoded: The Jews said, 'Will he kill himself? He says, “Where I go, you cannot come.”'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'You are from below; I am from above. You belong to this world; I do not.'

verses.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.decoded: I told you that you will die in your sins unless you believe that I am who I claim to be.'

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.decoded: They asked, 'Who are you?' Jesus answered, 'I am the one I have been telling you about from the beginning.'

verses.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.decoded: I have much to say about you and to judge you. But the one who sent me is true, and I tell the world what I heard from him.'

verses.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.decoded: They did not understand that he was talking about the Father.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am who I claim to be. I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father taught me.'

verses.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.decoded: The Father who sent me is with me. He has not left me alone because I always do what pleases him.'

verses.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.decoded: Many people believed in Jesus as he spoke these words.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.decoded: Then Jesus said to the Jews who believed him, 'If you remain in my teaching, you are truly my followers.'

verses.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.decoded: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

verses.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.decoded: They answered him, 'We are Abraham's descendants and have never been slaves to anyone. How can you say, You will be set free?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'I tell you the truth, anyone who sins is a slave to sin.'

verses.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.decoded: A slave does not remain in the house forever, but the Son remains forever.

verses.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.decoded: So if the Son sets you free, you will be truly free.

verses.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.decoded: I know you are Abraham's descendants, but you want to kill me because my message has no place in you.

verses.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.decoded: I speak what I have seen with my Father, but you do what you have heard from your father.

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.decoded: They said to him, 'Abraham is our father.' Jesus said to them, 'If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.'

verses.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.decoded: But now you want to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do this.

verses.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
verses.decoded: You are doing what your father does.' They said to him, 'We were not born from immoral relations; we have one Father— God.'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and came here on my own, not by myself, but he sent me.'

verses.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.decoded: Why don’t you understand what I say? It is because you cannot accept my message.

verses.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.decoded: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to do what he wants. He was a murderer from the beginning and has never told the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of lies.

verses.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.decoded: But because I tell you the truth, you do not believe me.

verses.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.decoded: Which of you can prove that I have sinned? If I tell the truth, why don’t you believe me?

verses.kjv: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
verses.decoded: Whoever belongs to God listens to what God says. You don’t listen because you don’t belong to God.

verses.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.decoded: The Jews answered, 'Aren’t we right in saying you are a Samaritan and have a demon?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.'

verses.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.decoded: I am not trying to bring glory to myself. There is someone else who is trying to bring glory and judge.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, if anyone obeys my teaching, they will never die.

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.decoded: Then the Jews said to him, 'Now we know you have a demon! Abraham and the prophets are dead, but you say, If anyone obeys my teaching, they will never taste death.'

verses.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.decoded: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets died too. Who do you think you are?

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'If I honor myself, my honor means nothing. It is my Father who honors me, the one you say is your God.'

verses.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.decoded: Yet you don’t really know him, but I know him. If I said I didn’t know him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know him and obey his teaching.

verses.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.decoded: Your father Abraham was happy to see my day and he saw it and was glad.'

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.decoded: Then the Jews said to him, 'You are not even fifty years old, and you have seen Abraham?'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'I tell you the truth, before Abraham was born, I am.'

verses.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.decoded: Then they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid and left the temple, walking through the crowd and going away.

verses.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.decoded: As Jesus walked by, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.

verses.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.decoded: His disciples asked him, 'Teacher, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so God's work could be shown in him.'

verses.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.decoded: I must do the work of the one who sent me while it is still day. Night is coming when no one can work.

verses.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.decoded: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

verses.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.decoded: After saying this, Jesus spat on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the blind man's eyes.

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.decoded: Then he told him, 'Go wash in the pool of Siloam' (which means Sent). So the man went, washed, and came back able to see.

verses.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.decoded: His neighbors and those who had seen him begging said, 'Isn't this the same man who used to sit and beg?'

verses.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.decoded: Some said, 'Yes, this is him.' Others said, 'No, he only looks like him.' But the man said, 'I am the one.'

verses.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'How were your eyes opened?'

verses.kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.decoded: He answered, 'A man named Jesus made mud, put it on my eyes, and told me to go wash in the pool of Siloam. So I went and washed, and now I can see.'

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.decoded: They asked, 'Where is this man?' He said, 'I don't know.'

verses.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.decoded: They took the man who had been blind to the Pharisees.

verses.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.decoded: It was the Sabbath day when Jesus made the mud and opened the man's eyes.

verses.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees asked the man again how he had received his sight. He said, 'He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and now I see.'

verses.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.decoded: Some Pharisees said, 'This man cannot be from God because he does not keep the Sabbath.' Others asked, 'How can a sinner do such miracles?' There was division among them.

verses.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.decoded: They asked the man again, 'What do you say about the man who opened your eyes?' He said, 'He is a prophet.'

verses.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.decoded: The Jewish leaders still did not believe that the man had been blind and could now see, so they called his parents.

verses.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.decoded: They asked, 'Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How can he now see?'

verses.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.decoded: His parents answered, 'We know this is our son and that he was born blind.

verses.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.decoded: But we don't know how he can see now or who opened his eyes. He is old enough; ask him. He can speak for himself.'

verses.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.decoded: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who had already agreed that anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah would be kicked out of the synagogue.

verses.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.decoded: So they said, 'He is old enough; ask him.'

verses.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.decoded: Then they called the man who had been blind again and said, 'Give glory to God! We know this man is a sinner.'

verses.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.decoded: He answered, 'I don't know if he is a sinner or not. One thing I do know is that I was blind but now I see.'

verses.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?'

verses.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.decoded: He answered, 'I already told you, but you didn't listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his followers too?'

verses.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.decoded: They insulted him and said, 'You are his follower, but we are followers of Moses.'

verses.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.decoded: They said, 'We know God spoke to Moses, but we don't know where this man comes from.'

verses.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.decoded: The man answered, 'Here is something amazing: you don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.'

verses.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.decoded: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but if anyone worships God and does what he wants, God listens to them.

verses.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.decoded: Since the world began, no one has ever heard of anyone opening the eyes of a person born blind.

verses.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.decoded: If this man were not from God, he could not do anything.

verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.decoded: They answered him, 'You were born completely sinful, and you teach us?' Then they threw him out.

verses.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.decoded: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out. When he found him, he asked, 'Do you believe in the Son of God?'

verses.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.decoded: He answered, 'Who is he, Lord? I want to believe in him.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'You have seen him, and he is the one talking with you.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Lord, I believe.' Then he worshiped Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I have come into this world to judge it. I came so those who cannot see might see, and those who think they see might become blind.'

verses.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.decoded: Some Pharisees who were with Jesus heard this and asked, 'Are we blind too?'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin. But since you say, "We see," your sin remains.'

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen through the gate but climbs in some other way is a thief and a robber.

verses.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.decoded: But the one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.decoded: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

verses.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.decoded: They will not follow a stranger but will run away from him because they do not recognize the voice of strangers.

verses.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.decoded: Jesus used this story, but they did not understand what he was telling them.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.decoded: So Jesus said again, I tell you the truth, I am the gate for the sheep.

verses.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.decoded: All who came before me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

verses.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.decoded: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out and find food.

verses.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.decoded: The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy. I came so they could have life, and have it fully.

verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.decoded: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives his life for the sheep.

verses.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.decoded: The hired man, who is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the sheep.

verses.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.decoded: The hired man runs away because he is only hired and does not care about the sheep.

verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.decoded: I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep, and my sheep know me.

verses.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.decoded: Just as the Father knows me and I know the Father, I give my life for the sheep.

verses.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
verses.decoded: I have other sheep that are not in this pen. I must bring them also. They will listen to my voice, and there will be one flock and one shepherd.

verses.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.decoded: The Father loves me because I give up my life so I can take it back again.

verses.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.decoded: No one takes my life from me. I give it up on my own. I have the power to give it up, and I have the power to take it back. This is what my Father has commanded me to do.

verses.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.decoded: Because of these words, many of the Jews were divided in their opinions.

verses.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.decoded: Some said, 'He has a demon and is crazy. Why do you listen to him?'

verses.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.decoded: Others said, 'These are not the words of someone controlled by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?'

verses.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.decoded: At that time, the Festival of Dedication was happening in Jerusalem, and it was winter.

verses.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
verses.decoded: Jesus was walking in the temple area near Solomon's Colonnade.

verses.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.decoded: The Jews surrounded him and asked, 'How long will you keep us in doubt? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'I have told you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father's name prove who I am.'

verses.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.decoded: But you do not believe because you are not my sheep, as I said to you.

verses.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.decoded: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

verses.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.decoded: I give them eternal life, and they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.

verses.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
verses.decoded: My Father, who gave them to me, is greater than all, and no one can snatch them from my Father's hand.

verses.kjv: I and my Father are one.
verses.decoded: I and the Father are one.

verses.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.decoded: Then the Jews picked up stones again to throw at him.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'I have shown you many good works from my Father; for which of these works are you going to stone me?'

verses.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.decoded: The Jews replied, 'We are not stoning you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, a man, are making yourself God.'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Is it not written in your law, "I said, You are gods"?'

verses.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.decoded: If those people, to whom God's word came, were called gods— and the scripture cannot be broken—

verses.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.decoded: then why do you say of the one whom the Father has set apart and sent into the world, "You are blaspheming," because I said, "I am the Son of God"?

verses.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.decoded: If I do not do my Father's works, do not believe me.

verses.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
verses.decoded: But if I do them, even if you do not believe me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I am in the Father.

verses.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.decoded: So they tried again to arrest him, but he escaped from their hands.

verses.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.decoded: Then he went away again across the Jordan to the place where John had first baptized, and he stayed there.

verses.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.decoded: Many people came to him and said, 'John did no miracle, but everything he said about this man was true.'

verses.kjv: And many believed on him there.
verses.decoded: And many believed in him there.

verses.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.decoded: There was a man named Lazarus who was sick. He lived in Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.decoded: This is the same Mary who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair. Her brother Lazarus was sick.

verses.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.decoded: So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, saying, 'Lord, the one you love is sick.'

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.decoded: When Jesus heard this, he said, 'This sickness will not end in death. It is for God's glory so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.'

verses.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.decoded: Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.

verses.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.decoded: When he heard Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was for two more days.

verses.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.decoded: Then he said to his disciples, 'Let's go back to Judea.'

verses.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.decoded: His disciples said, 'Teacher, the people there recently tried to stone you. Are you going back again?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'A day has twelve hours. Anyone who walks during the day won't stumble because they see the light of this world.'

verses.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.decoded: But anyone who walks at night will stumble because there is no light in them.'

verses.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.decoded: After saying this, he told them, 'Our friend Lazarus is sleeping, but I am going to wake him up.'

verses.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.decoded: His disciples said, 'Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.'

verses.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.decoded: But Jesus meant that Lazarus was dead, though they thought he was talking about resting.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus told them clearly, 'Lazarus is dead.'

verses.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.decoded: I am glad for your sake that I was not there, so you will believe. But let's go to him now.'

verses.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.decoded: Then Thomas, called Didymus, said to the other disciples, 'Let's go too, so we can die with him.'

verses.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
verses.decoded: When Jesus arrived, he found that Lazarus had been in the tomb for four days already.

verses.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.decoded: Bethany was near Jerusalem, about three miles away.

verses.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.decoded: Many Jews had come to comfort Martha and Mary about their brother.

verses.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
verses.decoded: When Martha heard Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.

verses.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.decoded: Martha said to Jesus, 'Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.'

verses.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
verses.decoded: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to her, 'Your brother will rise again.'

verses.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.decoded: Martha said, 'I know he will rise again when the dead are raised on the last day.'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.decoded: Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. Anyone who believes in me will live, even if they die.'

verses.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.decoded: And everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?'

verses.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.decoded: She said, 'Yes, Lord. I believe you are the Messiah, the Son of God who was to come into the world.'

verses.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.decoded: After she said this, she went to call her sister Mary privately. 'The Teacher is here and wants to see you,' she said.

verses.kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.decoded: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.

verses.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.decoded: Jesus had not yet entered the village but was still where Martha met him.

verses.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.decoded: The Jews who were with Mary in the house comforting her saw her get up quickly and go out. They followed her, thinking she was going to the tomb to cry there.

verses.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.decoded: When Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said to him, 'Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.'

verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw her crying, and the Jews with her crying too, he was deeply moved and troubled.

verses.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.decoded: He asked, 'Where have you put him?' They said, 'Lord, come and see.'

verses.kjv: Jesus wept.
verses.decoded: Jesus cried.

verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.decoded: Then the Jews said, 'Look how much he loved him!'

verses.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.decoded: Some of them said, 'Couldn’t this man who opened the eyes of the blind have kept this man from dying?'

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.decoded: Jesus, deeply troubled again, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone covering the entrance.

verses.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Take away the stone.' Martha, the dead man’s sister, said, 'Lord, by now he smells bad because he has been dead four days.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to her, 'Didn’t I tell you that if you believe, you will see God’s glory?'

verses.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.decoded: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was laid. Jesus looked up and said, 'Father, I thank you for hearing me.'

verses.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.decoded: I know you always hear me, but I said this for the people standing here, so they will believe you sent me.

verses.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.decoded: After saying this, Jesus shouted loudly, 'Lazarus, come out!'

verses.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.decoded: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with burial cloths, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said, 'Unwrap him and let him go.'

verses.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.decoded: Many of the Jews who had come to Mary and seen what Jesus did believed in him.

verses.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.decoded: But some went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

verses.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.decoded: Then the chief priests and Pharisees called a meeting and said, 'What should we do? This man is doing many miracles.'

verses.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.decoded: If we let him continue, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away our place and nation.

verses.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.decoded: One of them, Caiaphas, who was the high priest that year, said, 'You don’t understand anything.'

verses.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.decoded: 'You don’t realize it’s better for one man to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed.'

verses.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.decoded: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation.

verses.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.decoded: Not only for the nation, but also to bring together God’s children who were scattered everywhere.

verses.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.decoded: From that day on, they planned to kill Jesus.

verses.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.decoded: So Jesus stopped going openly among the Jews and went to a town near the wilderness called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

verses.kjv: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.decoded: The Jewish Passover was near, and many people went to Jerusalem from the country to purify themselves before the Passover.

verses.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.decoded: They were looking for Jesus and talking among themselves in the temple, 'What do you think? Will he not come to the feast?'

verses.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
verses.decoded: The chief priests and Pharisees had already ordered that if anyone knew where Jesus was, they should tell so they could arrest him.

verses.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.decoded: They prepared a meal for him there, and Martha served, while Lazarus was one of those sitting at the table with Jesus.

verses.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.decoded: Mary took a pound of expensive spikenard perfume, poured it on Jesus' feet, and wiped his feet with her hair. The whole house was filled with the scent of the perfume.

verses.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
verses.decoded: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, one of his disciples who was going to betray him, said,

verses.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.decoded: 'Why wasn't this perfume sold for three hundred silver coins and given to the poor?'

verses.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.decoded: He said this, not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief and kept the money bag and took what was put in it.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Leave her alone. She saved this perfume for the day of my burial.'

verses.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.decoded: 'You always have the poor with you, but you will not always have me.'

verses.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.decoded: Many Jews knew Jesus was there, and they came not only because of Jesus but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.decoded: The chief priests planned to kill Lazarus too,

verses.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.decoded: because many Jews were leaving them and believing in Jesus because of him.

verses.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: The next day, a large crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, 'Hosanna! Blessed is the King of Israel who comes in the name of the Lord!'

verses.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.decoded: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it,

verses.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.decoded: as it is written, 'Do not be afraid, daughter of Zion. Look, your King is coming, sitting on a donkey's colt.'

verses.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.decoded: At first, his disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified, they remembered that these things were written about him and that they had done these things to him.

verses.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.decoded: The people who were with Jesus when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead testified about it.

verses.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.decoded: That is why the crowd met him, because they heard about this miracle.

verses.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees said to each other, 'Do you see that you are gaining nothing? Look, the whole world has gone after him.'

verses.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.decoded: Some Greeks who had come to worship at the feast

verses.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.decoded: went to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and asked him, 'Sir, we want to see Jesus.'

verses.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.decoded: Philip told Andrew, and then Andrew and Philip told Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.'

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, unless a grain of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.

verses.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.decoded: Anyone who loves their life will lose it, but anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

verses.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.decoded: If anyone serves me, they must follow me, and where I am, my servant will be also. If anyone serves me, my Father will honor them.

verses.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.decoded: Now my soul is troubled. What should I say? 'Father, save me from this hour'? But this is why I came to this hour.

verses.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.decoded: 'Father, glorify your name.' Then a voice came from heaven, saying, 'I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.'

verses.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.decoded: The crowd standing there heard the voice and said it was thunder. Others said an angel spoke to him.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'This voice did not come for my sake, but for yours.'

verses.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.decoded: Now is the time for the world to be judged; now the ruler of this world will be driven out.

verses.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.decoded: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to me.

verses.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.decoded: He said this to show what kind of death he would die.

verses.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.decoded: The people answered him, 'We have heard from the law that the Messiah lives forever. How can you say, The Son of man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?'

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus told them, 'The light is still with you for a little while. Walk while you have the light, so that darkness will not catch you. Those who walk in darkness do not know where they are going.'

verses.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.decoded: While you have the light, believe in it, so you may become children of the light.' After saying this, Jesus left and hid himself from them.

verses.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.decoded: Even though he had done many miracles in front of them, they still did not believe in him.

verses.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.decoded: This fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, who said, 'Lord, who has believed what we have heard? And to whom has the power of the Lord been revealed?'

verses.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.decoded: That is why they could not believe, because Isaiah also said,

verses.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.decoded: 'He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they cannot see with their eyes or understand with their hearts and turn to me, and I would heal them.'

verses.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.decoded: Isaiah said these things when he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.decoded: Still, many of the leaders believed in him, but because of the Pharisees, they did not admit it, so they would not be kicked out of the synagogue.

verses.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.decoded: They loved human praise more than the praise of God.

verses.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.decoded: Jesus shouted, 'Anyone who believes in me does not just believe in me, but in the one who sent me.'

verses.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.decoded: Anyone who sees me sees the one who sent me.

verses.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.decoded: I have come as a light into the world, so that anyone who believes in me will not stay in darkness.

verses.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.decoded: If anyone hears my words but does not believe, I do not judge them, because I did not come to judge the world but to save it.

verses.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.decoded: But the one who rejects me and does not accept my words has a judge already—the message I have spoken will judge them on the last day.

verses.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.decoded: I do not speak on my own authority. The Father who sent me has commanded me what to say and how to say it.

verses.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.decoded: And I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is exactly what the Father told me to say.

verses.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.decoded: Before the Passover festival, Jesus knew that his time had come to leave this world and go to the Father. He loved his followers in this world and loved them completely.

verses.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
verses.decoded: After dinner, the devil had already put into Judas Iscariot's heart, the son of Simon, the idea to betray Jesus.

verses.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.decoded: Jesus knew that the Father had given him authority over everything, and that he had come from God and was going back to God.

verses.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.decoded: He got up from the meal, took off his outer clothes, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

verses.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.decoded: Then he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples' feet, drying them with the towel he was wearing.

verses.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.decoded: When he came to Simon Peter, Peter asked, 'Lord, are you going to wash my feet?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'You don't understand now what I am doing, but you will understand later.'

verses.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.decoded: Peter said, 'You will never wash my feet.' Jesus replied, 'If I don't wash you, you have no part with me.'

verses.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter said, 'Then not only my feet, but also my hands and my head.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Those who have had a bath only need to wash their feet to be completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.'

verses.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.decoded: Jesus knew who would betray him, so he said, 'You are not all clean.'

verses.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.decoded: After he had washed their feet, put on his clothes again, and sat down, he asked them, 'Do you understand what I have done for you?'

verses.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
verses.decoded: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you are right, because that is what I am.

verses.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
verses.decoded: If I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you should wash each other's feet.

verses.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.decoded: I have given you an example, so you should do what I have done for you.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, a servant is not greater than his master, and a messenger is not greater than the one who sent him.

verses.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.decoded: If you understand this, you will be blessed if you do it.

verses.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.decoded: I am not talking about all of you; I know the ones I have chosen. But this fulfills the scripture: 'The one who shares my bread has turned against me.'

verses.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
verses.decoded: I am telling you this now before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe that I am who I am.

verses.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.decoded: After saying this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and said, 'I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me.'

verses.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.decoded: The disciples looked at each other, wondering who he meant.

verses.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.decoded: One of Jesus' disciples, the one Jesus loved, was leaning close to him.

verses.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple to ask Jesus who he meant.

verses.kjv: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.decoded: So that disciple leaned back against Jesus and asked, 'Lord, who is it?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'It is the one I give this piece of bread to after I dip it.' Then he dipped the bread and gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.decoded: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus said, 'What you are about to do, do quickly.'

verses.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.decoded: None of those at the table understood why Jesus said this to Judas.

verses.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.decoded: Some thought Jesus was telling Judas to buy what they needed for the festival or to give money to the poor, since Judas was in charge of the money bag.

verses.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.decoded: After Judas took the bread, he left immediately. It was night.

verses.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.decoded: When Judas was gone, Jesus said, 'Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in him.'

verses.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.decoded: If God is glorified in him, God will also glorify him and will do so soon.

verses.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.decoded: My dear children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, 'You cannot follow me where I am going,' I now say the same to you.

verses.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.decoded: I give you a new command: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, you must love each other.

verses.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.decoded: Everyone will know that you are my followers if you love each other.

verses.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.decoded: Simon Peter asked him, 'Lord, where are you going?' Jesus answered, 'You cannot follow me now, but you will follow me later.'

verses.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.decoded: Peter said, 'Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I am ready to die for you.'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Will you really die for me? I tell you the truth, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.'

verses.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.decoded: Don't let your heart be troubled. Trust in God, and also trust in me.

verses.kjv: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.decoded: There are many rooms in my Father's house. If that were not true, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

verses.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
verses.decoded: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me, so that where I am, you may be also.

verses.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.decoded: You know where I am going, and you know the way to get there.

verses.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.decoded: Thomas said to him, 'Lord, we don't know where you are going, so how can we know the way?'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'

verses.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.decoded: If you really knew me, you would know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.'

verses.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.decoded: Philip said to him, 'Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.'

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Have I been with you so long, Philip, and you still do not know me? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. So how can you say, "Show us the Father"?'

verses.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.decoded: Don't you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I speak to you are not just my own. The Father living in me is doing his work through me.

verses.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
verses.decoded: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me. If not, believe because of the works themselves.

verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.decoded: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified through the Son.

verses.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
verses.decoded: If you ask me for anything in my name, I will do it.

verses.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.decoded: If you love me, obey my commandments.

verses.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.decoded: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper to be with you forever—

verses.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.decoded: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him because he lives with you and will be in you.

verses.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.decoded: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

verses.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.decoded: Soon the world will no longer see me, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.

verses.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.decoded: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

verses.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.decoded: Whoever has my commands and obeys them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.

verses.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.decoded: Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said to him, 'Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.'

verses.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
verses.decoded: Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
verses.decoded: I have told you these things while I am still with you.

verses.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.decoded: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.

verses.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.decoded: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.decoded: You heard me say, 'I am going away and I am coming back to you.' If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I am.

verses.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.decoded: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.

verses.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.decoded: I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no power over me.

verses.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.decoded: But I do this so that the world may learn that I love the Father and that I do exactly what the Father has commanded me. Come, let us go.

verses.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.decoded: I am the real vine, and my Father is the gardener.

verses.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.decoded: Every branch in me that does not produce fruit, he cuts off; and every branch that does produce fruit, he prunes so it will produce even more fruit.

verses.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.decoded: You are already clean because of the message I have given you.

verses.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.decoded: Stay connected to me, and I will stay connected to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit by itself unless it stays connected to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay connected to me.

verses.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.decoded: I am the vine, and you are the branches. Whoever stays connected to me, and I to them, will produce a lot of fruit. Without me, you can do nothing.

verses.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.decoded: If anyone does not stay connected to me, they are like a branch that is thrown away, dries up, and people gather it to throw it into the fire and burn it.

verses.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.decoded: If you stay connected to me and my words stay in you, ask for anything you want, and it will be done for you.

verses.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.decoded: This is how my Father is honored—when you produce a lot of fruit. Then you will be my disciples.

verses.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.decoded: Just as the Father has loved me, I have loved you. Stay in my love.

verses.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.decoded: If you obey my commands, you will stay in my love, just as I obey my Father’s commands and stay in his love.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
verses.decoded: I have told you these things so that my joy will be in you, and your joy will be complete.

verses.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.decoded: This is my command: Love each other as I have loved you.

verses.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.decoded: No one has greater love than to give their life for their friends.

verses.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.decoded: You are my friends if you do what I command.

verses.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.decoded: I no longer call you servants, because a servant doesn’t know what the master is doing. Instead, I call you friends because I have told you everything I heard from my Father.

verses.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.decoded: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit. Then the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.

verses.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.decoded: I command you to love each other.

verses.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
verses.decoded: If the world hates you, remember it hated me first.

verses.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.decoded: If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as its own. But you don’t belong to the world; I chose you out of the world, so the world hates you.

verses.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep your's also.
verses.decoded: Remember what I told you: A servant is not greater than the master. If they persecuted me, they will persecute you too. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours too.

verses.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.decoded: They will do all this to you because of my name, since they don’t know the one who sent me.

verses.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
verses.decoded: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.decoded: Anyone who hates me also hates my Father.

verses.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.decoded: If I had not done the miracles among them that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.

verses.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.decoded: This happened to fulfill what is written in their law: 'They hated me for no reason.'

verses.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.decoded: But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who comes from the Father— he will testify about me.

verses.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.decoded: And you also must testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
verses.decoded: I have told you these things so that you will not be upset.

verses.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.decoded: They will force you out of the synagogues. The time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are serving God.

verses.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.decoded: They will do this to you because they do not know the Father or me.

verses.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.decoded: I have told you this ahead of time so that when it happens, you will remember I warned you. I did not tell you this at first because I was still with you.

verses.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.decoded: But now I am going to the one who sent me, and none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

verses.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.decoded: You are sad because I have told you these things.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.decoded: But I tell you the truth: It is better for you that I go away, because if I do not, the Comforter will not come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
